name: Narendra Modi
role: Prime minister of India (2014–present); former chief minister of Gujarat
summary: Modi advocates national development through private enterprise, strategic state investment and targeted welfare. His speeches combine cultural preservation and national self-reliance with technological modernisation and international cooperation.
